日文.首段: 一畑電車7000系電車（いちばたでんしゃ7000けいでんしゃ）は、一畑電車が2016年（平成28年）より導入している、両運転台構造の直流形電車である。

章节.概要:
一畑電車では老朽化した既存車両を置き換えるため、東急1000系電車を譲受する方針だった。しかし同系列は他社からも引き合いが多く、必要数を確保できないことが判明した。このため、不足分は既存車の延命および車両の新造で補うことになり、開発されたのが本形式である。
自社発注の新造車両、および単行（1両）で運行可能な車両としてはデハニ50形以来86年ぶりであり、また90系以来となる20 m級車両である。
製造にはノックダウン方式が採られ、構体と台車の製作は近畿車輛に、艤装以降を西日本旅客鉄道（JR西日本）の関連会社・JR西日本テクノスの子会社である後藤工業（現：JR西日本後藤テック）に発注した。
1両あたりの新造費用は2億1,000万円で、費用の全額を国と沿線自治体が負担した（補助金）。JRの既存形式の車体と走行機器を組み合わせる設計を採用することで、コストを削減している。
2016年（平成28年）度と2017年（平成29年）度に各2両、合計4両が導入された。
章节.車体:
車体は、JR四国7000系電車をベースとした軽量ステンレス構造であるが、中扉の設置スペースが埋められている点が異なる。また製造に際し、JR四国より設計情報の無償提供を受けている。2016年（平成28年）秋に車体外装のラッピングデザインを公募で選定し、各車両に出雲大社、宍道湖、棚田、三瓶山をイメージしたデザインが採用されている。
側扉には半自動ドアボタンが設置されており、始発駅ならびに途中駅での長時間停車時には側扉の半自動扱いを行う。
章节.車内:
座席配置はJR四国7000系電車と同様にロングシートとクロスシートの点対称配置となっており、車体の大型化と相まって座席定員は64人と在来車より大幅に増加している。車内案内表示器は日本語と英語の2か国語対応となり、車内照明はDoライト製の直管型LEDが採用されている。ドアチャイムは都営地下鉄と同様のものが使用されている。またニチリンケミカル製の空気触媒「セルフィール」による抗菌・消臭・抗ウイルス処理が施工され、ドコモのmopera回線を利用した無料公衆無線LANサービスも提供している。
2018年3月より全車両に車内装飾が行われ、それぞれ外装に合わせたデザインの装飾と「しまねっこ」オブジェを配置している。
章节.走行機器:
基本的にJR西日本225系電車と同一のものを装備しており、一畑口寄りに電動台車、反対側に付随台車を配置する「0.5Mシステム」が採用されている。
主回路の制御装置（VVVFインバータ制御装置）と補助電源の制御装置（SIV）は、「車両制御装置」として一体化されており、この装置は東芝が製造している。主回路部はIGBT素子による2レベル電圧形PWMインバータ1基で2基の電動機を制御する、1C2M構成のVVVFインバータを搭載し、速度センサレスベクトル制御に対応する。補助電源部もIGBT素子を用いた2レベル電圧形PWMインバータを用いており､CVCF制御することで三相交流440 V/60 Hzを出力し、定格容量75 kVAを得る。
主電動機は、1時間定格出力270 kW/1,100 V、定格回転数2,955 rpm（許容5,830 rpm）の自己通風式かご形三相誘導電動機を1両あたり2基搭載する。
パンタグラフはシングルアーム式のものを松江しんじ湖温泉・電鉄出雲市側に1基搭載する。電動空気圧縮機（CP）はナブテスコ製のレシプロ式空気圧縮機を搭載する。
章节.運用:
第一号車のデハ7001は2016年（平成28年）12月11日に出発式を行い、翌12日より営業運転を開始した。残る3両も2017年（平成29年）中に順次導入される。2017年4月現在、運用は固定されており、2017年10月14日にはデハ7003が運行開始した。また、2018年3月4日にはデハ7004も運行を開始し、計画していた4両の導入が完了した。
平日は主に1両編成(一部2両編成)で全線の普通列車運用に就いている。休日は2両編成で普通列車の他に、電鉄出雲市～出雲大社前間の特急、出雲大社前→松江しんじ湖温泉の急行「出雲大社号」運用にも就いている。なお、2018年3月末から7月までの期間、3両編成で平日朝の特急「スーパーライナー」運用にも就いていた。

中文.首段: 一畑電車7000系電聯車（日語：一畑電車7000系電車／いちばたでんしゃ7000けいでんしゃ，羅馬化：Ichibata Densha 7000-kei densha）是一畑電車在2016年開始使用的電聯車，也是該公司自昭和初期導入DeHaNi 50型電聯車以來，時隔87年再度導入自主研發的新型車輛。

章节.概要: 自一畑電氣鐵道（現一畑電車）在1928年至1930年導入DeHaNi 50型電聯車後，該公司在日後導入的所有鐵路車輛均為向其他鐵路公司購入的退役二手車。但近年來為一畑電車提供資金援助的沿線自治體要求該公司削減營運成本，因此一畑電車在研擬將原本2輛1編組的運行模式改為單輛運行時決議導入全新打造的車輛。每輛車的造價約為2億1千萬日圓，並由日本中央政府及一畑電車鐵道路線沿線的自治體共同分擔。
章节.規格與構造:
由於7000系是以JR四國7000系電聯車為基礎進行製造，因此其正式型號結合電動普通車（日語：デハ /DeHa）之意訂為「DeHa 7000 系」；而該型車在製造時也獲得JR四國無償提供關於JR四國7000系的設計資訊。7000系在製造時採用散裝料的方式，其車體結構與轉向架由近畿車輛負責製作，艤裝極其之後的相關作業則發包給JR西日本旗下的後藤工業株式會社（現JR西日本後藤Tech）。

車體塗裝的設計以「出雲地區的風方」為主題進行公開徵募，最終選定以白色塗裝搭配橘色條紋的配色方案，並分別在7001－7004號車的車身上使用黑色、藍色、綠色及紅色的條紋，以描繪島根縣出雲大社、宍道湖、梯田以及三瓶山的意象。列車則搭載變頻器及再生制軔等設備，除節省能源外也提升乘客搭乘時的舒適度。客室內配備支援外語的相關設備，並安裝顯示日語及英語的車內資訊顯示器。而與一畑電車在2014年至2015年導入的一畑電車1000系電聯車相比，其載客總量達129人，多於1000系的載客總量。
章节.運用: 一畑電車在2016年至2017年間共導入4輛7000系電聯車。首輛車7001號於2016年12月11日在松江宍道湖溫泉站舉行首發典禮，7002號車於2017年3月投入使用。7003號車於2017年10月14日開始投入運行，最後1輛車7004號則於2018年3月4日投入運轉。

英文.词条标题: Ichibata Electric Railway 7000 series electric car
英文.首段: The Ichibata Electric Railway 7000 series (Ichibata Densha 7000-kei densha) is a DC electric car with a double-cab structure that Ichibata Electric Railway has been introducing since 2016 (Heisei 28).

章节.Overview: Ichibata Electric Railway had a policy of acquiring Tokyu 1000 series electric cars to replace its aging existing cars. However, it turned out that the series was in high demand from other companies as well, and the necessary number could not be secured. For this reason, it was decided to make up the shortfall by extending the life of existing cars and by building new cars, and this is the type that was developed. It is the first self-ordered newly built car, and the first car capable of single-car (one-car) operation, in 86 years since the Dehani 50 type, and is the first 20 m class car since the 90 series. The knock-down method was adopted for manufacture; the body shell and trucks were ordered from Kinki Sharyo, and outfitting and later work from Gotoh Industries (now JR West Gotoh Tec), a subsidiary of JR West Technos, an affiliate of West Japan Railway Company (JR West). The cost of building each car was 210 million yen, and the entire cost was borne by the national government and the municipalities along the line (subsidies). By adopting a design that combines the body of an existing JR type with running equipment, costs are reduced. Two cars were introduced in each of FY2016 (Heisei 28) and FY2017 (Heisei 29), four cars in total.
章节.Body: The body is of lightweight stainless steel construction based on the JR Shikoku 7000 series electric car, but differs in that the space for a center door is filled in. In addition, at the time of manufacture, design information was provided free of charge by JR Shikoku. In the autumn of 2016 (Heisei 28), the wrapping design for the car body exterior was selected by public competition, and designs evoking Izumo Taisha, Lake Shinji, terraced rice fields, and Mount Sanbe were adopted for each car. Semi-automatic door buttons are installed on the side doors, and the side doors are operated in semi-automatic mode when the train makes a long stop at the starting station or intermediate stations.
章节.Interior: The seat arrangement is a point-symmetric arrangement of longitudinal seats and cross seats, the same as the JR Shikoku 7000 series, and combined with the larger body, the seating capacity has increased greatly to 64, far more than existing cars. The passenger information display supports two languages, Japanese and English, and the interior lighting uses straight-tube LEDs made by Do Light. The door chime is the same as that used on the Toei Subway. In addition, antibacterial, deodorizing, and antiviral treatment is applied using the air catalyst 'Selfiel' made by Nichirin Chemical, and a free public wireless LAN service using NTT Docomo's mopera line is also provided. From March 2018, interior decoration was carried out on all cars, with decorations matching the exterior design of each and 'Shimanekko' objects placed.
章节.Running equipment: It is basically equipped with the same equipment as the JR West 225 series electric car, and adopts a '0.5M system' in which a motorized truck is placed toward the Ichibataguchi end and a trailer truck on the opposite side. The main circuit control device (VVVF inverter control device) and the auxiliary power supply control device (SIV) are integrated as a 'vehicle control device,' which is manufactured by Toshiba. The main circuit section is equipped with a 1C2M configuration VVVF inverter that controls two motors with one two-level voltage-type PWM inverter using IGBT elements, and supports speed-sensorless vector control. The auxiliary power supply section also uses a two-level voltage-type PWM inverter using IGBT elements, and by CVCF control outputs three-phase AC 440 V/60 Hz, obtaining a rated capacity of 75 kVA. Each car is equipped with two self-ventilated squirrel-cage three-phase induction motors with a one-hour rated output of 270 kW/1,100 V and a rated speed of 2,955 rpm (allowable 5,830 rpm). One single-arm pantograph is mounted on the Matsue Shinjiko-Onsen / Dentetsu-Izumo-shi side. For the motor-driven air compressor (CP), a reciprocating air compressor made by Nabtesco is installed.
章节.Operation: The first car, Deha 7001, held a departure ceremony on December 11, 2016 (Heisei 28) and began commercial operation on the 12th of the following month. The remaining three cars were also introduced sequentially during 2017 (Heisei 29). As of April 2017, the operation was fixed, and on October 14, 2017, Deha 7003 began operation. Also, on March 4, 2018, Deha 7004 began operation, completing the planned introduction of four cars. On weekdays it is mainly used as a single-car set (some two-car sets) for ordinary train services on the entire line. On holidays it is used as two-car sets for ordinary trains as well as for the limited express between Dentetsu-Izumo-shi and Izumo Taisha-mae, and the express 'Izumo Taisha' from Izumo Taisha-mae to Matsue Shinjiko-Onsen. In addition, from the end of March to July 2018, it was also used as three-car sets for the weekday morning limited express 'Super Liner.'

However, it turned out that the series was in high demand from other companies as well, and the necessary number could not be secured. For this reason, it was decided to make up the shortfall by extending the life of existing cars and by building new cars, and this is the type that was developed.
It is the first self-ordered newly built car, and the first car capable of single-car (one-car) operation, in 86 years since the Dehani 50 type, and is the first 20 m class car since the 90 series.
The knock-down method was adopted for manufacture; the body shell and trucks were ordered from Kinki Sharyo, and outfitting and later work from Gotoh Industries (now JR West Gotoh Tec), a subsidiary of JR West Technos, an affiliate of West Japan Railway Company (JR West).
The cost of building each car was 210 million yen, and the entire cost was borne by the national government and the municipalities along the line (subsidies). By adopting a design that combines the body of an existing JR type with running equipment, costs are reduced.
Two cars were introduced in each of FY2016 (Heisei 28) and FY2017 (Heisei 29), four cars in total.

== Body ==
The body is of lightweight stainless steel construction based on the JR Shikoku 7000 series electric car, but differs in that the space for a center door is filled in. In addition, at the time of manufacture, design information was provided free of charge by JR Shikoku. In the autumn of 2016 (Heisei 28), the wrapping design for the car body exterior was selected by public competition, and designs evoking Izumo Taisha, Lake Shinji, terraced rice fields, and Mount Sanbe were adopted for each car.
Semi-automatic door buttons are installed on the side doors, and the side doors are operated in semi-automatic mode when the train makes a long stop at the starting station or intermediate stations.

=== Interior ===
The seat arrangement is a point-symmetric arrangement of longitudinal seats and cross seats, the same as the JR Shikoku 7000 series, and combined with the larger body, the seating capacity has increased greatly to 64, far more than existing cars. The passenger information display supports two languages, Japanese and English, and the interior lighting uses straight-tube LEDs made by Do Light. The door chime is the same as that used on the Toei Subway. In addition, antibacterial, deodorizing, and antiviral treatment is applied using the air catalyst 'Selfiel' made by Nichirin Chemical, and a free public wireless LAN service using NTT Docomo's mopera line is also provided.
From March 2018, interior decoration was carried out on all cars, with decorations matching the exterior design of each and 'Shimanekko' objects placed.

== Running equipment ==
It is basically equipped with the same equipment as the JR West 225 series electric car, and adopts a '0.5M system' in which a motorized truck is placed toward the Ichibataguchi end and a trailer truck on the opposite side.
The main circuit control device (VVVF inverter control device) and the auxiliary power supply control device (SIV) are integrated as a 'vehicle control device,' which is manufactured by Toshiba. The main circuit section is equipped with a 1C2M configuration VVVF inverter that controls two motors with one two-level voltage-type PWM inverter using IGBT elements, and supports speed-sensorless vector control. The auxiliary power supply section also uses a two-level voltage-type PWM inverter using IGBT elements, and by CVCF control outputs three-phase AC 440 V/60 Hz, obtaining a rated capacity of 75 kVA.
Each car is equipped with two self-ventilated squirrel-cage three-phase induction motors with a one-hour rated output of 270 kW/1,100 V and a rated speed of 2,955 rpm (allowable 5,830 rpm).
One single-arm pantograph is mounted on the Matsue Shinjiko-Onsen / Dentetsu-Izumo-shi side. For the motor-driven air compressor (CP), a reciprocating air compressor made by Nabtesco is installed.

== Operation ==
The first car, Deha 7001, held a departure ceremony on December 11, 2016 (Heisei 28) and began commercial operation on the 12th of the following month. The remaining three cars were also introduced sequentially during 2017 (Heisei 29). As of April 2017, the operation was fixed, and on October 14, 2017, Deha 7003 began operation. Also, on March 4, 2018, Deha 7004 began operation, completing the planned introduction of four cars.
On weekdays it is mainly used as a single-car set (some two-car sets) for ordinary train services on the entire line. On holidays it is used as two-car sets for ordinary trains as well as for the limited express between Dentetsu-Izumo-shi and Izumo Taisha-mae, and the express 'Izumo Taisha' from Izumo Taisha-mae to Matsue Shinjiko-Onsen. In addition, from the end of March to July 2018, it was also used as three-car sets for the weekday morning limited express 'Super Liner.'
